scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentcrew/core && npm run build -w @agentcrew/hooks && npm run build -w @agentcrew/tts && npm run build -w @agentcrew/dock-windows && npm run build -w @agentcrew/dock-macos && npm run build -w @agentcrew/dock-linux && npm run build -w @agentcrew/panel
scripts.test: npm run test -w @agentcrew/core && npm run test -w @agentcrew/hooks && npm run test -w @agentcrew/tts && npm run test -w @agentcrew/dock-windows
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @agentcrew/core && npm run typecheck -w @agentcrew/hooks
scripts.install-hooks: npm run build -w @agentcrew/core && npm run build -w @agentcrew/hooks && node scripts/install-hooks.mjs
scripts.panel:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @agentcrew/panel
